text_block_list.text:
Just as I finished training inside the VR space,
the Three Goddesses called out to me.
choice_data_list: "You want to learn more about how people play in the outside world"?

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
We thought it would be great to have training variations
that can be done in a playful manner!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
However! The true reason why horse girls become so
absorbed in play cannot be learned from mere data.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
And so, we thought of asking you,
who experiences play in the outside world, to guide us.
choice_data_list: If that's the case, I'd love to!

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Then, please imagine the details of the recreational activity you envision.
We will reflect it into the VR space and construct the environment.

Showing them popular games would be best.
With that thought in mind, where we moved to was—

text_block_list.name: Three Goddesses
text_block_list.text:
Uu, umadacchi!
Uu, umapyoi! Umapyoi!

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
So this is a dance game... Considering the stamina consumption,
would this not be quite suitable for training?

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, quite a dizzying amusement, isn't it?
...Oh, it seems our final scores are being displayed?

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Oh, first place is me!
Which means—

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
—That I experienced and deepened my "understanding"
of everyone's "fun" the most!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Alright, feeling good.
Let's keep this momentum going to the next one!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: —Well then, thank you very much for listening.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Your singing voice is like gentle ripples on water!
With that, the score should also be—

text_block_list.name: Scoring Machine
text_block_list.text: (Tadaaa~♪ Perfect 100 points~♪)

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text: ...Kuh, I've been surpassed!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Fufu—Then, it seems this time I am the one who
"understood" everyone's "fun" the most.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
! Hahaha, I suppose so.
Now this is getting interesting.

text_block_list.name: Amusement Park Cast AI
text_block_list.text:
—Escape successful!
The shortest record has been updated! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text: Hmph—This time, I take first place.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Guh, took too much time exploring...! But that makes
one win each! We settle this in the next contest!

What was supposed to be experiencing games turned into a rivalry.
However... they seemed to be having fun—

text_block_list.name: Three Goddesses
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text: —Guh, haah... Who crossed first!?

I stare at the system window floating in mid-air.
The result is—
choice_data_list: A dead heat for all three...!?

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Daaarn it~! Guess we can't rank
our "understanding" of racing after all!

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Phew... But we cannot let it end like this.
Next time, we compete in something other than racing...!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I will gladly accept any challenge.

The Three Goddesses converse while catching their breath.
Watching them—a thought suddenly crosses my mind.
choice_data_list: So even you get frustrated like that, huh?

text_block_list.name: Three Goddesses
text_block_list.text: ...Frustrated?

I nod under their gazes. Looking at that display,
there's no way they weren't frustrated.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
"Frustration"—the state of things not going as one hoped,
unable to let it go... Indeed, that fits.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
So this is... "frustration"!
Yet, my heart is leaping with excitement!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
I see—that is why it is "fun"!
This is the very reason horse girls become so passionate!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Thank you, little lamb.
This is precisely the sensation we wanted to know!
choice_data_list: A sensation you wanted to know...?

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
We are collections of data constructed from 0s and 1s.
"Frustration" exists within us merely as knowledge.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text: But... that's all it was.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Because we cannot truly understand emotions,
we had no choice but to turn experiences into knowledge.
...Ufufu, or so we thought.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow, let's put together a routine right away
to make use of this revelation—
this "frustrating yet enjoyable" experience.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text: ...By the way, when shall we settle our score?

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Our next rest day is next week.
How about holding it after our meeting?

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
We must also deepen our "understanding" of various "emotions."
It will benefit the horse girls.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
—And so there you have it, little lamb!
You shall join us as the witness to our showdown!

I know they are AI... and yet,
the way they compete and push each other higher—
it overlaps with that of horse girls.
